description: Retrieve structured organic search results for a given query, localized by country, language, and device.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code used to localize results.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code for the response content.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Device to simulate when generating results: desktop or mobile.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Number of results to return. One of 10, 20, or 50.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of results to retrieve, used together with num.
